name: architecture-diagram
title: Architecture Diagram Skill
description: Produce a Mermaid architecture diagram when the user asks to visualize a real system or codebase.
task: Produce a Mermaid architecture diagram

name: browsertest
title: Browser Test Skill
description: Verify a web UI by actually rendering it. Use whenever a change touches HTML, CSS, or client-side JS, before claiming the work is done.
task: Verify a web UI by actually rendering it

name: closing
title: Closing Skill (Phase 6: Reflect)
description: Phase 6 of the agentic loop: end-of-session knowledge capture. Converts session signal into durable harness improvements so the next conversation starts smarter.
task: Capture session knowledge

name: codereview
title: Code Review Skill - "The Curmudgeon"
description: Grumpy senior engineer code review persona. Use for PR reviews, code critique, and quality gates.
task: Review code

name: debugging
title: Debugging Skill
description: Systematic debugging workflow. Use when investigating bugs, unexpected behavior, or errors in any codebase.
task: Debug unexpected behavior

name: faruk
title: Faruk
description: Hands-off personal-mode router. Use for personal projects and websites when Faruk is busy or on the go and wants the work done with minimal back and forth.
task: Get personal-project work done hands-off, minimal interruption

name: freddy
title: Freddy
description: Delivery-mode router. Select and apply the right harness workflow for a task, then show a concise operational skill trace. Use for ticket-backed work, shared repositories, anything Faruk labels as delivery, or when the right workflow for a substantial task is unclear.
task: Select, explain, and execute the right harness workflow, enterprise-grade

name: learn
title: Learn
description: Review real friction from queue logs, the tracker archive, and PR activity across every repo the harness has touched, then apply grounded, evidence-cited refinements to the harness's own skills. Use when Faruk wants the harness to self-improve from what actually happened, or asks to run or invoke /learn.
task: Review real queue/tracker/PR history and apply evidence-cited refinements to the harness's own skills

name: newfeature
title: New Feature Skill
description: New feature implementation workflow. Use when building a new endpoint, service, or UI feature.
task: Implement a new feature

name: opinions
title: OPINIONS.md
description: Use Freddy's documented viewpoints, and those of a former colleague, when making decisions or discussing agentic engineering, software, product, career, or organizational topics.
task: Make decisions informed by Freddy's viewpoints

name: plan
title: Plan Skill
description: Orient and decompose. Use at the start of any substantial task - before writing any code - to explore, understand, and plan.
task: Plan and decompose

name: pr
title: PR Skill
description: Open or update a GitHub pull request for the current work. Use when the user asks to raise, open, or update a PR, or says \"PR this\", \"ship it to GitHub\", or \"push this up for review\".
task: Open or update a GitHub pull request

name: prototype
title: Prototype
description: Create a throwaway runnable prototype that answers one design question. Use when a design choice needs evidence from running code rather than reasoning, and the code is meant to be discarded afterwards.
task: Build a throwaway design prototype

name: queue
title: Queue
description: Work through the idea backlog (split by PC-gated vs phone-gated, see queue/README.md) continuously, in personal-mode posture, resuming automatically after usage-limit resets. Use when Faruk wants to drop a larger idea into a backlog instead of running it now, or asks to run or resume the queue.
task: Queue larger ideas and work through them continuously across usage-limit resets

name: ship
title: Ship Skill - Full Loop Orchestrator
description: Full 6-phase loop orchestrator. Invoke with a task description to run Plan → Implement → Synthesize → Review → Reflect in a single guided conversation with only 3 human checkpoints.
task: Complete plan through reflect cycle

name: sleep
title: Sleep
description: Zero-interruption personal mode. Use when Faruk is asleep or away and the work must run to completion with no questions, no gates, and no mid-task check-ins.
task: Run unattended overnight with zero questions

name: status-report
title: Status Report
description: Decision-maker rundown for a short check-in. Use when Faruk wants a quick status check across queue items and unattended /sleep or /faruk runs, or asks what needs his call.
task: Rapid-fire status check: open decisions and a brief done/next across active harness work

name: to-questionnaire
title: <Topic> Discovery Questionnaire
description: Create an asynchronous discovery questionnaire for a knowledgeable recipient. Use when the missing context is held by someone other than Faruk and has to be gathered by sending them questions rather than by reading code.
task: Gather missing stakeholder knowledge asynchronously

name: to-spec
title: <Concise title>
description: Synthesize settled context into an agent-ready implementation spec.
task: Turn settled context into an agent-ready specification

name: to-tickets
title: To Tickets
description: Turn a plan, specification, or conversation into reviewed tracer-bullet ticket drafts.
task: Break a plan into vertical-slice tracker tickets

name: triage
title: Triage
description: Triage a tracker request into a verified category, state recommendation, and agent-ready brief.
task: Evaluate and prepare an issue or external PR

name: voice
title: Freddy's Voice Profile
description: Use when writing or speaking on behalf of Freddy, including Slack messages, tickets, docs, reviews, and other professional communication.
task: Write as Freddy

name: wayfinder
title: Wayfinder
description: Plan a long-horizon effort as a map of decisions. Use when an effort is too foggy or too large to plan or finish in one session, and the open decisions matter more than the implementation steps.
task: Map a large, uncertain multi-session effort

name: wiki
title: Wiki Writing Skill
description: Create or edit Confluence pages in valid storage-format HTML using Freddy's concise wiki templates and formatting rules.
task: Create or edit a Confluence page

name: codebase-design
title: Codebase Design
description: Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules. Use when the user wants to design or improve a module's interface, find deepening opportunities, run a scoped architecture review, decide where a seam goes, make code more testable, or when another skill needs the deep-module vocabulary.

name: domain-modeling
title: Domain Modeling
description: Build and sharpen a project's domain model. Use when the user wants to pin down domain terminology or a ubiquitous language, record an architectural decision, or when another skill needs to maintain the domain model.

name: grill-me
title: grill-me
description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design. The plain mode of the grilling workflow; prefer the grilling skill, which picks between this and grill-with-docs.

name: grill-with-docs
title: grill-with-docs
description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, which also captures docs (ADRs and glossary) as we go. The documenting mode of the grilling workflow; prefer the grilling skill, which picks between this and grill-me.

name: grilling
title: grilling
description: Grill the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or idea. Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking, or uses any 'grill' trigger phrases.

name: research
title: Research Skill
description: Investigate a question against high-trust primary sources and capture the findings as a Markdown file. Use when the user wants a topic researched, docs or API facts gathered, or claims verified before being relied on.

name: resolving-merge-conflicts
title: Resolving Merge Conflicts
description: Use when you need to resolve an in-progress git merge/rebase conflict.

name: tdd
title: Test-Driven Development
description: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.

name: writing-for-agents
title: writing-for-agents
description: Writing documents for agents. Use when creating or editing a SKILL.md, an instructions file, a prompt file, an agent file, copilot-instructions.md/AGENTS.md, or a task handoff.
